title: Reader TTS settings tab treats voice loading as no available mainland voices
symptom: When the reader opens the TTS settings tab before the system voice catalog has loaded, the sheet can display the empty-result message "已筛除非大陆中文音色，当前将使用系统默认音色。" and stale default-voice status even though the voice list is still loading.
root_cause: ReaderTtsRuntimeState only stored availableVoices as a list. An empty list represented both 'not loaded yet' and 'loaded but no selectable voices remain', so ReaderTtsSettingsSheet could not render an accurate loading state.
fix: Changed ReaderTtsController.updateAvailableVoices to mark the voice catalog loaded even when the result list is empty.
Changed StoryApplication.preloadReaderTtsVoices to stop using non-empty voices as the only preload-complete signal.
Changed preload to pass the raw voice-loading Result into ReaderTtsController so initialization failure does not mark the catalog as loaded.
Changed ReaderSettingsSheet and ReaderTtsSettingsSheet to render a loading message before the voice catalog has loaded, and only show default/empty-result status after loading completes.
Passed the loaded flag from ReaderScreen into the settings sheet and suppressed stale system-default voice status while voices are still loading.
failed_attempts: Do not infer voice-catalog load completion from availableVoices.isEmpty(); empty is a valid loaded result after mainland-Chinese filtering.
Do not show the system-default fallback message while availableVoicesLoaded is false, because a persisted voice may still become selectable once loading completes.

Do not convert a failed voice-catalog Result to emptyList before updating runtime state; that permanently confuses initialization failure with a successful loaded-empty catalog and prevents preload retry.
impact: Prevents the TTS settings tab from briefly or permanently presenting an inaccurate no-voice/default-voice state while the system voice catalog is still being loaded.
